column2: # Remove non running dogs and irrelevant markets
# Calculate implied probabilities and create a race id
# Create a df with total probability and runners per race
a <- data %>% group_by(RID) %>% summarise(mprob = sum(prob), runners = n())
# Filter out races where the market isn't set and only includes races with 8 dogs
RIDs <- a %>% filter(mprob < 1.02 & mprob > 0.98 & runners == 8) %>% select(RID) %>% pull()
